goal: Complete the model-registry hard cut so the repo persists, exposes, imports, and renders the new OpenRouter-first model schema with modelId, contextLength, architecture, reasoning, pricing, and shared reasoningApi relations, with no operational support for removed or renamed legacy fields.
architectureSummary: First change the Drizzle schema and shared model contracts to the final OpenRouter-first shape, including jsonb fields and a versioned shared reasoningApi relation. Then rewrite repository, service, server, importer, analytics, plugin, and web consumers to use the new contract directly. Finally, refresh regression coverage and docs so the hard cut is durable and no compatibility logic remains.
globalConstraints: PostgreSQL continua sendo a única source of truth.
Drizzle schema continua sendo a fonte da verdade para migrations.
O contrato público de API, services e frontend usa apenas camelCase.
Este trabalho é um hard cut: não devem permanecer aliases operacionais de compatibilidade para os campos removidos/renomeados.
Nenhum adapter, service, route, fixture ou componente deve manter leitura ou escrita de formatos deprecated como estratégia de transição.
Todo consumer impactado no repo deve ser atualizado para o novo contrato na mesma implementação.

requirementsChecklist.title: Persist the new model schema in PostgreSQL/Drizzle without legacy columns
requirementsChecklist.source: SPEC-0010 Contract + OpenRouter-first fields + Persistence and boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: model_proxy_models stores model_id, context_length, architecture, reasoning, pricing, supportedParameters, defaultParameters, and perRequestLimits in the final schema.
Removed columns owned_by, vision, context_window_size, metadata, model-level upstream fields, and flattened pricing fields no longer exist operationally.
UNIQUE(provider_id, model_id) is the canonical model identity in persistence.
notes: architecture, reasoning, and pricing stay as jsonb in this round.

requirementsChecklist.title: Expose only the canonical camelCase model contract across API, services, and frontend
requirementsChecklist.source: SPEC-0010 Flow + Model contract + Persistence and boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: Public payloads use modelId, contextLength, canonicalSlug, architecture, reasoning, pricing, supportedParameters, defaultParameters, and perRequestLimits.
API/services/frontend no longer accept or emit modelName, contextWindowSize, ownedBy, vision, metadata, or model-level upstream fields.
snake_case remains restricted to import/adapters and persistence boundaries.

requirementsChecklist.title: Import OpenRouter metadata into the app without redefining its semantic structure
acceptanceCriteria: OpenRouter importer maps context_length, architecture, pricing, supported_parameters, default_parameters, and per_request_limits into the canonical app contract.
Imported data is converted to camelCase for public app surfaces while preserving OpenRouter field semantics.
Optional missing OpenRouter fields persist as null or empty typed values without fabricated defaults.

requirementsChecklist.title: Unify thinking and reasoning into a single reasoning field
acceptanceCriteria: The model contract has one reasoning block and no separate thinking block.
reasoning.apiMode or equivalent nested duplication is absent.
Repository, server, plugins, and web consumers read the unified reasoning field directly instead of metadata bridges.

requirementsChecklist.title: Model provider-specific reasoning request shapes through a shared versioned reasoningApi relation
requirementsChecklist.source: SPEC-0010 Reasoning API relation + edge case 8
acceptanceCriteria: A shared relational reasoningApi entity exists with provider, explicit version, requestParams, and requestShape.
Models can reference the shared reasoningApi entity without duplicating payload-shape blobs inline.
Incompatible reasoning payload changes are represented by new reasoningApi versions rather than silent mutation.

requirementsChecklist.title: Resolve upstream/provider routing from relations instead of model-level duplicated fields
acceptanceCriteria: Model-level upstream_model, upstream_base_url, and provider_name are removed from the model contract and persistence layer.
Server and analytics surfaces resolve provider identity from relations instead of removed columns.
Web model screens stop editing model-level upstream routing fields.

requirementsChecklist.title: Keep the models administration UI functional on the new schema
acceptanceCriteria: Model list, detail, edit, create, and sync flows operate on the new contract directly.
UI labels and diffs reflect architecture, pricing, supported parameters, and context length instead of removed fields.
Reasoning UI uses the unified reasoning configuration and no longer exposes nested apiMode or legacy toggles.

requirementsChecklist.title: Apply a repo-wide hard cut with no operational legacy support
requirementsChecklist.source: SPEC-0010 Objective + Persistence and boundaries + DoD
acceptanceCriteria: No shim, alias, dual-read, dual-write, or deprecated-format adapter remains in impacted surfaces.
Internal consumers depending on removed or renamed fields are updated instead of preserved through compatibility logic.
Regression tests fail loudly if removed keys or old semantics reappear.
notes: This requirement is cross-cutting and applies to every implementation task.

rules: Never start implementation on main without explicit user consent.
Never re-dispatch a task already marked completed in the registry or logs.
Keep the hard cut strict: no compatibility shim, alias, dual-read, or dual-write for removed model fields.
Update every directly impacted consumer in the same implementation package.
Treat public API/services/frontend contracts as camelCase and persistence/import boundaries as the only place for snake_case.
